items.caption: An oracle-bone form of 年, rendered with 禾 above a human-shaped element. This matches the early harvest interpretation, though the shape alone does not establish the lower element’s sound role.
items.alt: Black oracle-bone-style graph on white: a branching grain-like form above a separate, human-shaped lower form.
items.selection_reason: The visible graph is legible and illustrates the sourced pictorial interpretation of 年 as grain above a person, associated with harvest use.

limitations.text: This rendering illustrates one proposed pictorial reading. Whether the lower 人 also had a phonetic role remains disputed, and the evidence does not establish a complete dated path from harvest to the later senses of year, New Year, and age.
